The mjs version uses top-level await; the cjs version wraps the call in an async IIFE.\n\n```mjs\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\n\nawait assert.rejects(\n  async () => {\n    throw new TypeError('Wrong value');\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'TypeError',\n    message: 'Wrong value',\n  },\n);\n\n```\n\n```cjs\nconst assert = require('node:assert/strict');\n\n(async () => {\n  await assert.rejects(\n    async () => {\n      throw new TypeError('Wrong value');\n    },\n    {\n      name: 'TypeError',\n      message: 'Wrong value',\n    },\n  );\n})();\n\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### assert.deepStrictEqual(actual, expected[, message])\n\nSource: https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v24.x/api/assert.json\n\nTests for deep strict equality between actual and expected parameters.
